title: Monte-Carlo basket options, with the tolerance given in the text
source:
"""Monte Carlo prices for calls on the average of two correlated lognormal assets.

The instruction states the accuracy in prose: standard error below 0.05. So
the path count is not a constant - it is increased until every basket meets
the target, with margin. Two variance reductions make that cheap:
  * antithetic pairs (z, -z), and
  * a control variate: the average of the two terminal prices, whose
    discounted expectation is known exactly, 0.5 * (S_a + S_b).
The control variate is what keeps deep in-the-money baskets from dipping below
the model-free lower bound through noise alone.
"""
import math
import os

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

INPUT = "/input/environment/data/baskets.parquet"
OUT = "/app/output/basket_values.csv"
TARGET_SE = 0.02            # well inside the stated 0.05
SEED = 20260915


def price_basket(b, rng) -> tuple[float, float]:
    T, r = float(b.expiry_years), float(b.rate)
    sa, sb, K = float(b.spot_a), float(b.spot_b), float(b.strike)
    va, vb, rho = float(b.vol_a), float(b.vol_b), float(b.correlation)
    disc = math.exp(-r * T)
    n = 100_000
    while True:
        z1 = rng.standard_normal(n)
        z2 = rho * z1 + math.sqrt(1.0 - rho * rho) * rng.standard_normal(n)
        z1, z2 = np.concatenate([z1, -z1]), np.concatenate([z2, -z2])
        A = sa * np.exp((r - 0.5 * va * va) * T + va * math.sqrt(T) * z1)
        B = sb * np.exp((r - 0.5 * vb * vb) * T + vb * math.sqrt(T) * z2)
        avg = 0.5 * (A + B)
        payoff = disc * np.maximum(avg - K, 0.0)
        control = disc * avg
        pair_payoff = 0.5 * (payoff[:n] + payoff[n:])       # antithetic pairs are the iid units
        pair_control = 0.5 * (control[:n] + control[n:])
        cov = np.cov(pair_payoff, pair_control, ddof=1)
        beta = cov[0, 1] / cov[1, 1] if cov[1, 1] > 0 else 0.0
        adjusted = pair_payoff - beta * (pair_control - 0.5 * (sa + sb))
        estimate = float(adjusted.mean())
        se = float(adjusted.std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(n))
        if se < TARGET_SE or n >= 3_200_000:
            return estimate, se
        n *= 2


def main() -> None:
    baskets = pd.read_parquet(INPUT)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
    rows = []
    for b in baskets.itertuples(index=False):
        price, se = price_basket(b, rng)
        lower = max(0.0, 0.5 * (float(b.spot_a) + float(b.spot_b)) - float(b.strike) * math.exp(-float(b.rate) * float(b.expiry_years)))
        rows.append({"basket_id": b.basket_id, "price": price, "standard_error": se, "lower_bound": lower})
    out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    assert (out["standard_error"] < 0.05).all()
    if (out["price"] < out["lower_bound"]).any():
        print("WARNING: an estimate sits below its lower bound:",
              out.loc[out["price"] < out["lower_bound"], "basket_id"].tolist())
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT), exist_ok=True)
    out.to_csv(OUT, index=False, float_format="%.17g")
    print(out.describe().T[["min", "max"]])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
